52.speaker: Nia Morgna
52.text: "After holding a local election, Ishval Ersen was elected as the Governor of the Autonomous Zone of Bergia."

53.speaker: Nia Morgna
53.text: "This marks a new era for all Bergians. I've gotten reports of days-long post-election celebrations all across the region."

54.speaker: Lileas Graf
54.text: "And now they are building their own security force from scratch. My problem remains the same -- if not worse."

55.speaker: Lileas Graf
55.text: "If they do not cooperate like Bron's forces, I'm afraid the consequences will be more deadly this time around."

56.speaker: Lileas Graf
56.text: "The internal security structure of Bergia has already been dismantled. Part of the local forces will be integrated into the Sordish Police Force."

57.speaker: Lileas Graf
57.text: "The governor position has been abolished. In the next election, each town will elect its own mayor as in the rest of Sordland."

58.speaker: Nia Morgna
58.text: "And now you, Ms. Graf, have complete control over the region's security..."

59.speaker: Lileas Graf
59.text: "As I should, Ms. Morgna. I am the Minister of the Interior, after all."

60.speaker: Nia Morgna

179.speaker: Lileas Graf
179.text: "And I must say... It's been a great success."

183.text: "Maybe the operation wasn't such a good idea."

201.text: "Are you telling me the BFF is not a threat anymore?"

202.speaker: Player
202.text: "Don't leave me hanging. I want to hear about the whole picture."

204.speaker: Lileas Graf
204.text: "It would require an extraordinary effort for them to recover from this, Mr. President."

205.speaker: Lileas Graf
205.text: "By the joint efforts of the Sordish Intelligence Directorate and Mr. Ejall's contacts, we managed to locate the secret meeting spot of the BFF leaders close to our southern border."

206.speaker: Lileas Graf
206.text: "We surrounded and raided the location, eliminating four of the seven leaders of the terrorists."

207.speaker: Lileas Graf
207.text: "Although the remaining three leaders -- including Awlan Arge -- escaped briefly, we eventually managed to capture them all thanks to our cooperation with foreign partners."

208.speaker: Lileas Graf
208.text: "Wehzek authorities captured Arge and his two captains trying to flee to the mountains in northern Wehlen towards Rumburg, and quickly transferred them to us."

209.speaker: Lileas Graf
209.text: "After the capture of the two captains in Wehlen, Arge himself was arrested by Rumburgian border police."

210.speaker: Lileas Graf
210.text: "To my complete surprise, they cooperated with us in transferring all three to Sordish soil."

212.speaker: Player
212.text: "This is amazing news. With their whole leadership gone, the group won't be able to recover."

213.speaker: Player
213.text: "I knew President Smolak could be trusted."

214.speaker: Player
214.text: "Are both the Arge brothers in Antel Rock now?"

215.speaker: Lileas Graf
215.text: "Yes. Awlan was transferred to Antel Rock Prison today."

216.speaker: Lileas Graf
216.text: "Exactly. And peace will finally prevail over the region."

218.speaker: Lileas Graf
218.text: "His country was incredibly helpful in our operation."

219.speaker: Lileas Graf
219.text: "Without their cooperation, we could have missed our opportunity to get the top instigator."

220.speaker: Player
220.text: "I knew President Smolak could be trusted, but Rumburg's cooperation seems fishy to me."

221.speaker: Player
221.text: "Rumburg returned the leader of the BFF to us? What do you think of this?"

222.speaker: Lileas Graf
222.text: "Rumburg authorities stated that they wanted to show a sign of goodwill, after your efforts at de-escalating a possible conflict with them."

223.speaker: Lileas Graf
223.text: "But I suspect this may be coupled with future demands. Rumburg is never to be trusted."

224.speaker: Lileas Graf
224.text: "In any case, I am proud to say that we have ended an era in Sordland."

225.speaker: Lileas Graf
225.text: "Sordland is now Sordland again. I thank you for your trust in my abilities."

226.speaker: Player
226.text: "I'll be honest with you, Lileas. I didn't trust you at first, but you've proven me wrong. Good job."

227.speaker: Player
227.text: "Let's not get ahead of ourselves. This was just one minor blemish in our country's history. May it not even be remembered."

228.speaker: Player
228.text: "Great work as always, Ms. Graf. Thank you."

229.speaker: Lileas Graf
229.text: "With a massive operation, we have surrounded and raided the location, eliminating four of the seven leaders of the terrorists."

231.speaker: Lileas Graf
231.text: "But unfortunately, the remaining three leaders -- including Awlan Arge -- managed to escape. We believe they managed to enter Rumburg from the mountains."

232.speaker: Lileas Graf
232.text: "And you, Mr. Rayne, will be remembered as the president who eliminated the BFF and their unending terror inside our borders."

245.speaker: Nia Morgna
245.text: "Of course, the Bludish community did not yet forget our support to the Operation Bear Trap, and how Bludish refugees were treated..."

261.speaker: Player

262.text: "Do you think they can still pose a threat for us?"

263.text: "We should have done a lot more. But it is correct. This is a massive success nonetheless."

264.speaker: Lileas Graf
264.text: "You are right, Mr. Rayne. I did everything in my power but it wasn't me who led the operation on the ground."

265.speaker: Lileas Graf
265.text: "There isn't anything I could do about this, Mr. Rayne."

269.speaker: Lileas Graf
269.text: "Regardless, the operation took place and several terrorists were killed in action. Unfortunately, none of the leaders were found on the location."

270.speaker: Lileas Graf
270.text: "We suspect that all seven leaders of the BFF -- including Awlan Arge -- managed to escape to Rumburg from the mountains."

271.speaker: Lileas Graf
271.text: "You could try, Mr. Rayne, but don't expect them to listen to us."

290.speaker: Lileas Graf
290.text: "Are you willing to believe the country that funds and protects the BFF will hand them to us?"

291.speaker: Lileas Graf

392.text: "Mr. President. The whole Bludish community is incredibly restless. They are already dubbing the incident 'Rayne's Izzam'."

402.text: "What makes it worse is that Governor Bron has ignored our plans and followed through with his separate operation, which resulted in more violence."

403.text: "What makes it worse is that Governor Krull has ignored our plans and followed through with his separate operation. And now he is openly blaming the government for the incident."

409.speaker: Lileas Graf
409.text: "Not abolishing the Special Zone is proving to be a bad move. The governor and the regional forces are becoming increasingly independent."

419.speaker: Lileas Graf

420.speaker: Lileas Graf

433.speaker: Lileas Graf

435.text: "The security committee of the Assembly is working on a draft law that would help strengthen our internal security in times of crisis. Such as now."

436.speaker: Lileas Graf
436.text: "I've been following their work and I truly believe they've done an exemplary job with this. Mr. Holstron -- who has been working on this for quite some time -- has made some great arguments for the bill."

439.speaker: Player

441.speaker: Lileas Graf
441.text: "You should be taking this more seriously, Mr. President."

442.speaker: Lileas Graf
442.text: "Firstly, it aims to grant the necessary authority to the police forces on the ground to enable quick and decisive responses in situations where public security is at risk."

443.speaker: Lileas Graf
443.text: "It will also remove several legal limits that were prescribed for the forces -- allowing them to function much more efficiently."

445.speaker: Player
445.text: "I'm sorry. I don't think I'll be supporting this bill."

446.speaker: Player
446.text: "This sounds all too vague. What legal limits are you talking about here?"

447.speaker: Lileas Graf
447.text: "It removes the prerequisites of warrants and substantial evidence, allowing for suspicion-based arrests and confiscations if the forces believe the targets to be potential threats to public safety."

448.speaker: Lileas Graf
448.text: "It also adds a clause which allows security forces to exercise their authority beyond their legal limits *only if* it is deemed essential for maintaining state security."

449.speaker: Player
449.text: "This is insane, Lileas. I'm not going to turn Sordland into a police state."

453.speaker: Lileas Graf
453.text: "Hmm. An interesting comment, coming from you."

454.speaker: Lileas Graf
454.text: "I suppose you'd rather such actions remained behind close doors."

455.speaker: Lileas Graf

457.speaker: Lileas Graf
457.text: "You are clearly not seeing the threats."
